## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

- [ ] I added or updated regression tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:unit`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run compile` and `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.zh-TW.md` in Traditional Chinese.
- [ ] My commit subject contains English and Traditional Chinese.

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No API key, token, personal data, private source, or full provider response is included.
- [ ] This change does not add provider/model/business-domain special cases.
- [ ] I documented remaining limitations or manual verification.
